instrument_name: NM TRD FYI-104 New Mexico Withholding Tax (Rev. 11/2025), effective 2026-01-01
authority: New Mexico Taxation and Revenue Department
article_or_section: Who Must Withhold; Amount to Withhold; Supplemental Wages; Special Situations; Tables 1-8
figure_or_rule_carried: No NM state W-4: employee completes the federal W-4 marked For New Mexico State Withholding Only (convenience, not mandatory); percentage-method tables (Tables 1-8, rates 1.5% to 5.9%), standard deduction built in and W-4 allowance deduction removed; no withholding if the total for an employee in any one month is under 1 USD; NM resident: withhold on all wages wherever earned; nonresident: only wages earned in NM; supplemental wages: same method as federal, and if federal uses a flat percent withhold a flat 5.9% (Table 8 recommended for separately paid bonus/overtime); married employee at the higher single federal rate uses the single rate; worked example Table 1 weekly married band 790-1,098 = 12.77 + 4.3% of excess over 790; quarterly report TRD-41431 due the 25th after quarter end from quarter beginning 2026-01-01 (HB 218); returns TRD-41414 and TRD-41409 electronic; annual withholding statements electronic by last day of January; gambling winnings 6%; Native American on tribal land and active-duty military income exempt (W-4 Step 4(c)); extra state withholding via the NM-only W-4
